faqs.question: How do I place an order?
faqs.answer: Simply browse our products, select the plan you want, and click 'Order Now'. This will redirect you to WhatsApp where you can complete your order.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Most products are delivered instantly within minutes after payment confirmation.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept eSewa, Khalti, bank transfer, and other local payment methods.

faqs.question: Are your products genuine?
faqs.answer: Yes! All our products are 100% genuine and sourced directly from authorized channels.

faqs.question: What is Game Shop Nepal?
faqs.answer: We are an online store providing digital game items, subscriptions, and services at affordable prices with fast delivery. Our mission is to offer a smooth and reliable buying experience.

faqs.question: Do I need an account to make a purchase?
faqs.answer: No. You can buy as a guest, but creating an account helps you track orders and access support faster.

faqs.question: What if my item isn’t delivered?
faqs.answer: If your order doesn’t arrive within the expected time, contact our support team with your order number for tracking.

faqs.question: Why are your prices lower than some other sites?
faqs.answer: We source and price digital products competitively while maintaining quality, fast delivery, and transparency.

faqs.question: What information do I need to provide?
faqs.answer: Only the required game ID, character ID, or account identifier — we never ask for your password or sensitive personal data.

faqs.question: Is my data secure?
faqs.answer: Yes. We use secure systems and industry-standard protection to safeguard your information.

faqs.question: Can I get a refund?
faqs.answer: Since most products are digital and delivered instantly, refunds are only possible for delivery failures or technical issues. Contact support with your order ID for assistance.

faqs.question: What if my top-up or subscription doesn’t work?
faqs.answer: Provide us with the order number and error details — we’ll investigate and resolve it promptly.

faqs.question: How do I get help if I have a problem?
faqs.answer: Reach out to our support team via the Contact Us page; we will assist you as soon as possible.

faqs.question: What kinds of products do you sell?
faqs.answer: We offer digital subscriptions, game currencies, items, and other digital services for popular games and platforms.

faqs.question: Can I cancel or change my order?
faqs.answer: Digital orders are processed instantly — once placed, they cannot usually be canceled or changed. Contact us quickly if you made a mistake.
